violated_contract: A durable workstream label must name a project, product, or goal. Accepting a technology or activity noun (api, meetings, config) that merely appears in the observations and has two supporting groups lets the same failure the per-visit tagger had — invented surface and activity names — into the vocabulary that routes candidates and pooling.
canonical_prevention: Reject generic labels at the tagging acceptance boundary with a deterministic stop-list, including compounds whose every kebab token is generic, independent of the prompt and of the two-group / appears-in-observations gates. Abstention (unknown) stays a drop, not a label.
